### Added

- *(mcpserver)* Progress restarts a tool call's timeout, up to spec.progress.maxDuration in [#1487](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1487) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)

### Changed

- Align files according to platform standards in [#1488](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1488) by [@giantswarm-align-files[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-align-files[bot])

- *(deps)* Update module github.com/giantswarm/mcp-toolkit to v0.2.16 in [#1476](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1476) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- *(deps)* Update module github.com/giantswarm/apptest-framework/v5 to v5.3.3 in [#1483](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1483) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
